purpose: Historical-development decoding-policy experiment: greedy baseline vs compression-ratio temperature fallback. Diagnoses the 30 degeneration views found in the frozen evaluation.
authorization: User supplied Modal GPU access and asked for tests and experiments to be run.

scope_limits.data: historical development split only, 12 sources / 24 views
scope_limits.fresh_100_evaluated_set: SEALED - not read, not re-run, not used for selection
arms: a: greedy scalar temperature 0, no fallback
b: temperature ladder with compression-ratio guard
scope_limits.changed_variable: ASR decoding policy only; model, revisions, prompts, waveforms and token ceiling held fixed

reservation.note: Estimate from the Modal rates recorded in MODAL_GPU_HANDOFF.md (A10 + 2 CPU + 16 GiB). Storage and egress excluded. Actual gross usage must be read from workspace billing, not inferred from this file.

stopping_rule: One submission, zero retries. If arm A waveform hashes fail or the job errors, record the failure and stop; do not resubmit without review.

pre_registered_read.primary: corpus WER on the 24 dev views, arm B minus arm A
secondary: count of views whose Whisper compression ratio exceeds 2.4 before and after
count of views still hitting the 224-token ceiling
per-view regressions (any view whose WER increases)
ASR wall-clock delta and per-view latency ratio
pre_registered_read.decision: Fallback advances to a fresh held-out evaluation only if corpus WER improves, no more than a small bounded number of views regress, and latency increase is modest. WER improvement alone is an ASR result, not a QA result.
